prompt_metadata.title: GeoNex Heavy Engineering Execution Blueprint: Advanced Vector Geoprocessing & Spatial Analysis Engine
prompt_metadata.description: Comprehensive, deterministic, step-by-step execution prompt in JSON format to implement the complete QGIS Processing and ArcGIS Pro Analysis Toolbox equivalent into GeoNex (.NET 10 / C# / SkiaSharp / NTS / GDAL).
standards_parity: ArcGIS Pro 3.x Analysis & Geoprocessing Toolbox (Overlay, Proximity, Aggregation)
OGC Simple Features Access for SQL (SFA-SQL / ISO 19125)
prompt_metadata.strict_memory_discipline: Zero-allocation in rendering loops; STRtree 2D spatial indexing for O(N log M) batch overlays

threading_and_concurrency.execution_thread: Dedicated background worker (Task.Run) decoupled from Blazor Server/Hybrid UI thread
threading_and_concurrency.progress_notification: System.IProgress<GeoprocessingProgress> with percentage (0.0 to 1.0), processed count, total count, elapsed time, and rate (features/sec)
threading_and_concurrency.cancellation: System.Threading.CancellationToken checked every batch iteration; cooperative termination within 50ms without leaking temp files
threading_and_concurrency.semaphore_guard: System.Threading.SemaphoreSlim(1, 1) to prevent race conditions during concurrent geoprocessing executions
threading_and_concurrency.ui_synchronization: InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged) throttling (maximum 10 UI repaints per second) to prevent Webview message saturation

spatial_indexing.bounding_box_filter: Mandatory EnvelopeInternal intersection check prior to invoking full geometric predicate (Intersects/Intersection/Difference)
spatial_indexing.fast_path_containment: If input feature bounding box is fully contained within mask polygon and mask.Contains(feature) is true, bypass geometric cutting

coordinate_reference_systems.on_the_fly_reprojection: Dynamic CoordinateTransformation (OSGeo.OSR) if Layer A and Layer B CRS differ
coordinate_reference_systems.metric_preservation: Geodesic vs Cartesian distance auto-detection; planar UTM metric computation for buffers; WGS84 angular conversion guard
coordinate_reference_systems.projection_file_generation: ESRI Shapefile .prj generation in compliant OGC/ESRI WKT format
coordinate_reference_systems.datum_transformation_grids: Support for NTv2 or proj datum shift when transforming between SAD69, Córrego Alegre, SIRGAS2000, and WGS84

topological_resilience.validation_pipeline: IsValidOp check before executing boolean operations
topological_resilience.auto_repair_level_1: Buffer(0) repair for self-intersecting rings (bow-tie polygons)
topological_resilience.auto_repair_level_2: SnapRounding / Micro-grid precision reduction for floating-point arithmetic drift
topological_resilience.sliver_polygon_filtering: Automatic elimination of degenerate polygons whose area is below tolerance threshold (1e-7 m²)

attribute_engineering.dbf_10_character_rule: Strict truncation of column names exceeding 10 bytes ASCII
attribute_engineering.collision_resolution: Deterministic suffixing (_1, _2, _3) when Layer A and Layer B contain identical field names
attribute_engineering.type_preservation: Exact mapping between NTS AttributesTable and OGR FieldType (OFTInteger, OFTInteger64, OFTReal, OFTString, OFTDate)
attribute_engineering.codepage_handling: Writing corresponding .cpg file with UTF-8 or CP1252 declaration to prevent character corruption

ui_styling_and_ux.emoji_rule: Zero emojis in all UI code, button labels, logs, menus, and modals
ui_styling_and_ux.visual_style: Enterprise Cartographic Desktop (dark slate palette, SVG vector icons, monospace technical metrics, high-density parameter inputs)
ui_styling_and_ux.real_time_canvas_update: Automatic injection of output layer into active project layers with immediate SkiaSharp layer dispatch
ui_styling_and_ux.keyboard_shortcuts: Esc to cancel modal, Enter to execute when parameters are valid

clip_algorithm.name: Recortar (Vector Clip)
clip_algorithm.spatial_predicate: Intersection with topological dimension guard: dim(G'_i) == dim(G_i)
clip_algorithm.time_complexity: O(N log M + K) with STRtree 2D pre-indexing
clip_algorithm.input_requirements: Input layer: Points, Lines, Polygons; Mask layer: Polygon or MultiPolygon
clip_algorithm.schema_behavior: Input layer attributes copied 100% intact; mask attributes discarded
edge_cases: Feature completely outside mask envelope: immediate O(1) drop
Feature completely inside mask envelope and mask.Contains(feature): immediate O(1) pass-through
Feature partially intersecting mask: exact NTS Intersection computation
Line tangent to polygon boundary: dimension guard prevents point-like artifacts
verification_assertions: Assert(clipped.Area <= input.Area, 'Clipped geometry area must be less than or equal to input')
Assert(mask.Contains(clipped) || mask.Intersects(clipped), 'Clipped geometry must reside within mask boundary')

intersection_algorithm.name: Intersecção (Vector Intersection)
intersection_algorithm.mathematical_definition: G_{ab} = G_a ∩ G_b for all (a, b) where a ∈ A, b ∈ B and G_a.Intersects(G_b)
intersection_algorithm.spatial_predicate: DE-9IM Intersects(G_a, G_b) with dim(G_ab) == min(dim(G_a), dim(G_b))
intersection_algorithm.time_complexity: O(N log M + K) utilizing STRtree spatial index on layer B
intersection_algorithm.input_requirements: Two vector layers of matching or compatible geometry types
intersection_algorithm.schema_behavior: Merged schema containing all columns of Layer A and Layer B; column collisions renamed with _1, _2 suffixes
edge_cases: Identical column names in A and B (e.g., 'NAME'): B column renamed to 'NAME_1'
Column name reaching 10-char limit ('POPULATION'): truncated to 'POPULAT_1'
Non-overlapping bounding boxes: skipped instantly in STRtree query
verification_assertions: Assert(intersected.Area <= Math.Min(geomA.Area, geomB.Area), 'Intersection area cannot exceed either input')
Assert(mergedAttrs.Exists('COLUNA_1'), 'Column collision must produce indexed suffix')

difference_algorithm.name: Diferença Espacial (Vector Difference / Erase)
difference_algorithm.spatial_predicate: NTS Difference between feature geometry and unified erase mask
difference_algorithm.input_requirements: Input layer: Polygons or Lines; Erase layer: Polygons
difference_algorithm.schema_behavior: Input layer schema preserved 100%; Erase layer attributes discarded
edge_cases: Erase mask splitting a polygon in two: converted automatically to MultiPolygon
Erase mask entirely covering feature: feature completely suppressed
Erase mask touching boundary only: boundary tangency lines discarded by dimension extractor
verification_assertions: Assert(diffArea < inputArea, 'Difference must subtract overlapping area')
Assert(!diffGeom.Intersects(eraseGeom.Interior), 'Difference geometry cannot intersect interior of erase mask')

dissolve_algorithm.name: Dissolver Geometrias (Vector Dissolve)
dissolve_algorithm.spatial_predicate: CascadedPolygonUnion for optimal O(N log N) tree-based polygonal union
dissolve_algorithm.schema_behavior: Dissolve All outputs summary schema; Dissolve by Attribute preserves group key plus aggregations
edge_cases: Dissolve All: single unified geometry with total count attribute
Dissolve by Attribute: dictionary partition by field value before cascading union
Disjoint polygons with same attribute: emitted as valid MultiPolygon
Null or empty field values: grouped safely into '<NULO>' partition
verification_assertions: Assert(dissolvedCount == distinctCategories, 'Output feature count must match category count')
Assert(dissolvedArea ≈ sumInputArea, 'Total area must be preserved after internal boundary elimination')

buffer_algorithm.name: Zona de Amortecimento em Lote (Layer Buffer Engine)
buffer_algorithm.time_complexity: O(N) per feature, O(N log N) if dissolve enabled
buffer_algorithm.input_requirements: Input layer: Points, Lines, Polygons; Distance: Metric (meters) or field-driven
buffer_algorithm.schema_behavior: All input attributes preserved; new columns 'BUF_DIST' added
edge_cases: Negative buffer on polygon: shrinking polygon with ring elimination if d exceeds inradius
High quadrant segments (32): smooth circular arcs without angular facets
EndCapStyle Flat on line: clean perpendicular end cuts
Buffer dissolve enabled: all intersecting buffer rings merged via CascadedPolygonUnion
verification_assertions: Assert(Math.Abs(pointBuffer.Area - Math.PI * 100) < 5.0, 'Point buffer area must approach π * r²')

convex_hull_algorithm.name: Envoltória Convexa (Convex Hull)
convex_hull_algorithm.mathematical_definition: CH(S) = { ∑ α_i p_i | p_i ∈ S, α_i >= 0, ∑ α_i = 1 }
convex_hull_algorithm.spatial_predicate: NTS ConvexHull using Monotone Chain / Graham Scan algorithm
convex_hull_algorithm.time_complexity: O(N log N) per geometry or layer
convex_hull_algorithm.schema_behavior: Global mode creates 1 feature with count; Feature mode preserves original attributes
edge_cases: Collinear points: generates LineString instead of degenerate polygon
Single point input: returns Point
Two points: returns LineString
Three or more non-collinear points: returns valid Polygon
verification_assertions: Assert(hull.Contains(inputGeometry) || hull.Covers(inputGeometry), 'Convex hull must cover all input vertices')
Assert(hull.Area >= inputGeometry.Area, 'Convex hull area must be >= input geometry area')

centroid_algorithm.name: Centroides & Polylabel (Centroids & Inaccessible Poles)
centroid_algorithm.mathematical_definition: C_mass = (1 / 6A) ∑ (x_i + x_{i+1})(x_i y_{i+1} - x_{i+1} y_i); Polylabel = argmax_{p ∈ P} min_{e ∈ ∂P} dist(p, e)
centroid_algorithm.spatial_predicate: NTS Centroid with Polylabel interior clearance guarantee for concave geometries
centroid_algorithm.time_complexity: O(1) for Centroid; O(K log S) for Polylabel QuadTree sampling
centroid_algorithm.schema_behavior: Output layer: Point geometry with 100% of original polygon attributes copied
edge_cases: Convex polygon: Centroid is inside, fast-path used directly
Concave polygon (horseshoe / C-shape): Centroid falls outside; Polylabel shifts point inside
MultiPolygon: Centroid placed on largest sub-polygon; Polylabel finds deepest inscribed circle
verification_assertions: Assert(concavePolygon.Contains(polylabelPoint), 'Polylabel must be strictly inside concave geometry')
Assert(pointFeature.Attributes['ID'] == polygonFeature.Attributes['ID'], 'Attributes must be copied intact')

spatial_join_algorithm.name: União Espacial (Spatial Join)
spatial_join_algorithm.mathematical_definition: Join(A, B) where Predicate(A.Geometry, B.Geometry) is True
spatial_join_algorithm.time_complexity: O(N log M + K) using STRtree on Layer B
spatial_join_algorithm.input_requirements: Target layer A and Join layer B of any geometry type
spatial_join_algorithm.schema_behavior: One-to-One with summary (COUNT_B, SUM_*, AVG_*) or One-to-Many duplication
edge_cases: Zero intersecting features in B: attributes of B populated with NULL/defaults
Multiple intersecting features in B: aggregated into COUNT and statistical summaries

error_codes.name: EmptyInputLayerException
error_codes.description: A camada de entrada selecionada não contém feições válidas para processamento.
error_codes.remedy: Verifique a fonte de dados e se há feições não corrompidas no arquivo Shapefile.

error_codes.name: IncompatibleGeometryTypeException
error_codes.description: A operação requer um tipo específico de geometria (ex: máscara de corte deve ser Polígono).
error_codes.remedy: Converta a camada de máscara para polígonos ou utilize uma camada compatível.

error_codes.name: CoordinateTransformationException
error_codes.description: Falha na reprojeção matemática entre os sistemas de referência espacial (CRS).
error_codes.remedy: Verifique a definição WKT/PROJ das camadas de entrada e sobreposição.

error_codes.name: TopologySelfIntersectionException
error_codes.description: Geometria de entrada possui auto-interseções que falharam após 3 níveis de reparo.
error_codes.remedy: Aplique a ferramenta Corrigir Geometria previamente na camada.

error_codes.name: ShapefileWritePermissionException
error_codes.description: Não foi possível criar ou gravar o arquivo Shapefile no diretório de destino especificado.
error_codes.remedy: Verifique as permissões de gravação no disco ou se o arquivo já está aberto em outro processo.

error_codes.name: ProcessCancelledByUserException
error_codes.description: O processamento foi interrompido cooperativamente por solicitação do usuário.
error_codes.remedy: Nenhuma ação necessária; arquivos temporários incompletos são excluídos automaticamente.
